description: A scripting mod for Minecraft without the issues of other scripting mods.

releases.notes:
> [!WARNING]
> This version has breaking changes! More details below.

## Breaking Changes

- Read scripts as UTF-8 regardless of system charset *[commit by @Rongmario in bb8c765]*
  - Scripts are always read as UTF-8. Scripts saved in another encoding, such as ANSI on Windows, must be re-saved as UTF-8.
    *[Fixes issue #349 by @seferlian]*

## Bug Fix

- Find loot tables not registered in LootTableList *[commit by @Rongmario in 5873657]*
    *[Fixes issue #298 by @3A70]*
- Fix different platforms having different behavior for sorting *[commit by @WaitingIdly in bfbb4b6]*

## Build and Dependencies

- Move to conventions & make things buildable again *[commit by @Rongmario in df3a2de]*

## Other

- Fix ReEntrantTransformerError by avoiding class loading in GroovySecurityManager *[commit by @DeliciousBread481 in a6df8b7]*
- Fix Copy keybind failing in JEI *[PR by @WaitingIdly in #383]*
